LESSON: LETTER WRITING.

Grade: SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2
Subject: General
Strand: WRITING
Topic 3.1: Letter writing.
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 2

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Letter writing., part of WRITING in SNE  /  physical-impairment / PP2 General.

Key inquiry question: How do we tell whether letter is upper case or lower case?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

Follow your teacher’s guidance for group work, discussion, and practice on this topic.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Letter writing. together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

Core Competencies:

• Learning to learn: The learner persists to learn about letter creating and learns that letters of the alphabet can be written in

both lower and upper case and can be modelled.

• Creativity and imagination: The learner writes letters of the alphabet in the air imaginatively with the picture in mind of

how the letter looks on a book.
